stem:
The diagram shows Earth in its orbit around the sun when very little light is visible at Earth's South Pole.

Which statement is true when Earth is in the position shown?

options.label: F
options.text:
It is August in the Northern Hemisphere.
It is April in the Southern Hemisphere.

options.label: G
options.text:
It is summer in the Northern Hemisphere.
It is winter in the Southern Hemisphere.

options.label: H
options.text: The number of hours of daylight is greater in the Southern Hemisphere than in the Northern Hemisphere.

options.label: J
options.text: Spring begins earlier in the year in the Southern Hemisphere than it does in the Northern Hemisphere.

visual_elements: Diagram showing Earth orbiting the Sun in a position where the South Pole is mostly shaded and labeled north (N) on the top
